reading: The sketch lays out a three-column email client plus a small floating window: a left sidebar, a middle message list, a right reading pane, and a floating compose window overlapping the bottom-right of the reading pane.

Add a floating 440x470px white compose window overlapping the page, flush to the page bottom and 20px from the right edge, with rounded top corners only and a b
